title: Feature-Space Smoothing: Certified Robustness of Deep Representations
abstract: arXiv:2601.16200v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern deep learning models exhibit strong capabilities across diverse applications, yet remain vulnerable to malicious inputs that induce erroneous predictions via feature-space distortion. To address that, we propose Feature-Space Smoothing (FS), a representation-level certification framework built upon Gaussian randomized smoothing. We show that FS converts a given feature encoder into a smoothed variant that is guaranteed to maintain a certified lower bound on the cosine similarity between clean and adversarial features under l_2-bounded perturbations. translated_title: 特征空间平滑：深度表示的认证鲁棒性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.16200v4 公告类型：替换 摘要：现代深度学习模型在各类应用中展现出强大的能力，但仍然容易受到恶意输入的攻击，这些恶意输入会通过特征空间失真引发错误的预测。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了特征空间平滑，这是一个基于高斯随机平滑构建的表示级认证框架。我们证明，FS 可以将给定的特征编码器转换为一个平滑变体，该变体在 l₂ 有界扰动下能够保证维持干净特征与对抗特征之间余弦相似度的认证下界。随后，我们确立了这个特征余弦相似度界（FCSB）可以扩展到基于余弦相似度度量的预测级认证，并且 FCSB 的值由编码器固有的高斯鲁棒性分数决定。基于这些见解，我们引入了高斯平滑增强器，这是一个即插即用模块，用于提升编码器的高斯鲁棒性。
tldr: 该论文提出基于高斯随机平滑的特征空间平滑（FS）框架，在表示层面为深度模型提供干净与对抗特征间余弦相似度的认证下界，并引入即插即用的高斯平滑增强器（GSB）来提升编码器的高斯鲁棒性分数。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Feature-Space Smoothing (FS), a representation-level certification framework based on Gaussian randomized smoothing that guarantees a certified lower bound on cosine similarity between clean and adversarial features, together with a plug-and-play Gaussian Smoothness Booster (GSB) to enhance the encoder's Gaussian robustness score.
